title: Closing remarks
summary: Interviewers ask if anything was left out; Manuel and Penn say they have covered it.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Was there any other point that you forgot to tell us the other day that you wanted to make a note of?

Well, there were many things that I couldn't think of at the time, but even though now, I couldn't think of them. Because there were so many things that happened and... That's right, everybody played with almost everyone else I did. I can't remember the different bands I played. I played with every musician in the city. That's the bone, yeah. That's right, what I've done. I played with them. I played banjo with them. Oh, yeah. I played saxes, alto saxes with them. I played tenor with them. Mm-hmm. See? So those things, you will forget them. Yeah. But I think Sammy Pins have... He did very well to remember.
Yeah, I think you did too. I mean, there's nothing else you want to add? We'll just... Well...
No, Mr. Bill, I... I just about... I think I remembered all about doing the time. I think it's very well to go.
